name: stackbone
description: Agent skills for Stackbone: the App Store + hosting for AI agents. Creators publish containerized agent templates; organizations install them as agents that run with their own Postgres (Neon + pgvector), object storage (R2), queues (QStash), HITL inbox and LLM gateway (OpenRouter). This plugin gives coding agents the full Stackbone surface: @stackbone/sdk (database, storage, AI, RAG, queues, approval), CLI for scaffolding and publishing (init, dev, publish, db migrate), and diagnostics for HITL, runs, logs, secrets and metrics.
